login.title: Sign in
login.tenantHeading: Sign in to the Tenant Portal
login.platformHeading: Sign in to the Platform Console
login.tenantHint: For example: tenant-a — lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
login.tenantInvalid: Invalid tenant ID: 3–32 characters, starting with a letter, lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only.
login.platformHint: For platform staff. Signing in always requires a password and a second factor.
login.expired: Your session has expired or was revoked. Please sign in again.

tenantSelect.title: Choose a tenant
tenantSelect.noMemberships: This account is not a member of any active tenant.
tenantSelect.noGrants: No active Support Access Grant. Access to a tenant is only possible through a grant approved by that tenant.

tenant.suspendedBanner: This tenant is suspended: every write is refused, data is read-only.

unavailable.title: Not available yet
unavailable.planned: This screen has not been built yet (task {{task}}). No placeholder figures are shown.
unavailable.postMvp: Post-MVP feature (task {{task}}) — there is no data source yet, so no figures are shown.

notFound.title: Not found
notFound.description: This page or resource does not exist, or you do not have access to it.

forbidden.title: Not allowed
forbidden.description: Your current role is not allowed to view this screen.

stepUp.title: Re-authentication required
stepUp.description: This action is sensitive and requires that you authenticated within the last 15 minutes. Re-authenticate, then repeat the action.

rateLimit.wait_one: Too many requests. Try again in {{count}} second.
rateLimit.wait_other: Too many requests. Try again in {{count}} seconds.

maintenance.banner: The platform is under maintenance. Some features are temporarily unavailable.

problem.unauthenticated: You are not signed in or your session has expired.
problem.reauth_required: Re-authentication is required for this action.
problem.forbidden: You are not allowed to perform this action.
problem.tenant_suspended: This tenant is suspended — writes are refused.
problem.quota_exceeded: The plan's quota has been exceeded.
problem.conflict: Conflicts with the current state — reload and try again.
problem.precondition_failed: The data was changed by someone else — reload and try again.
problem.precondition_required: The data version (If-Match) is missing — reload and try again.
problem.idempotency_key_reuse: The idempotency key was reused with a different request.
problem.rate_limited: Too many requests — wait, then try again.
problem.upstream_rejected: An upstream system refused the request.
problem.instance_unavailable: The tenant's control plane is temporarily not responding.
problem.not_implemented: This function is not implemented on the server yet.

ui.readOnlyActions: The tenant is read-only: changes are disabled.

kinds.tenant_suspended: Tenant {{tenant}} has been suspended — data is read-only.
kinds.tenant_deleted: Tenant {{tenant}} was deleted; its data keys will be destroyed after {{keys_destroy_after}}.
kinds.device_expiring: Device {{device_name}} expires at {{expires_at}} — it must re-authenticate.
kinds.support_grant_requested: Platform staff {{staff}} requests a Support Access Grant — the tenant must decide.
kinds.support_break_glass: Break-glass: {{staff}} was granted emergency support access (approved by {{approver}}).
kinds.support_grant_used: Platform staff {{staff}} acted in the tenant through a Support Access Grant.
kinds.approval_requested: A new approval request is waiting: {{action}}.
kinds.idp_admin_change: Administrative change at the Identity Provider: {{action}} (by {{actor}}).
kinds.instance_restored: The tenant's control plane was restored from the backup of {{backup_created_at}}.

dashboard.onlineNote: Online as seen by the control plane at the last sync — not a measurement of the network path.

reasons.never_synced: The device inventory has never been synced — no figures yet.
reasons.no_source: The platform has no data source for this section yet.
reasons.not_served: A source exists but the overview does not serve this figure yet.

reason.circuit_open: Calls to the instance paused after repeated failures.
reason.api_key_rejected: The platform's API key was rejected.
reason.edge_rejected: The edge refused the administrative call.
reason.not_located: The tenant's instance could not be located.
reason.stale: The last check result is stale.

devices.noOsNote: Operating system, client version and endpoints are not shown: the Headscale API does not provide them (HS-14).
devices.tagInvalid: A tag looks like tag:<name> (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens).

review.title: Review of tagged nodes that never expire
review.description: Tagged nodes never expire and have no owner (HS-19, PL-09) — review them periodically (quarterly) and revoke the ones no longer used (§7.4, ADR-23).
review.empty: No tagged node that never expires.

explain.pending: The {{kind}} was accepted — waiting for Headscale to confirm (read-back). The device is NOT revoked until the state is "applied".
explain.applied: The {{kind}} is applied: Headscale confirmed it on read-back.
explain.failed: The {{kind}} failed: Headscale refused or the retries ran out. The device may still have access — try again.

deleted.title: Device deleted
deleted.description: Headscale confirmed the deletion: the device is no longer in the inventory.

rename.title: Rename
rename.label: Name in the tailnet (DNS label)
rename.hint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; 1–63 characters; no leading or trailing hyphen.

revoke.title: Revocation
revoke.description: Revocation has two phases: the request is recorded at once, and it is "applied" only once Headscale confirms it.
revoke.confirmExpire: The device's key expires now: it loses tailnet access until it signs in again.
revoke.confirmDelete: The device is removed from the tailnet and from the inventory. Using it again requires a new registration.
revoke.twoPhase: This page follows the request until Headscale confirms it.

relay.intro: The tenant's DERP relays: the assigned regions and the platform's latest probe.
relay.empty: No relay is assigned to this tenant yet.

reasons.unsupported: The component does not provide this figure (the embedded DERP exports no relay metrics).
reasons.no_source: The platform has no source for this figure yet.

healthReason.relay_unreachable: The relay is unreachable (DERP and STUN).
healthReason.stale: The last probe result is stale.
healthReason.no_probe: This kind of region is not probed yet.
